page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 4 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Text processing tasks also demonstrate high efficiency. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth for large blocks fall into the average category. Weaknesses are observed in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, database operations, and Redis SET operations, which register in the bottom 25% of benchmarks.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers a stable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring consistent single-core performance without the overhead of local storage or GPU accelerators. Recommended workloads include lightweight web serving, text processing pipelines, single-threaded application servers, and general-purpose utility hosting where high-density multi-core scaling or extreme memory bandwidth is not a primary requirement.
